title: Disruption of c-Myc/Max heterodimerization induced by a novel anticancer agent endowed with 1,3-diphenylurea moiety: an in silico, chemoproteomics-based, and in vitro combined approach.
authors: Gazzillo, Erica; Capasso, Lucia; Scala, Francesca; Aliberti, Michela; Capuano, Alessandra; D'Urso, Gilda; Bruno, Ines; Mele, Donato; Reginelli, Alfonso; Lauro, Gianluigi; Casapullo, Agostino; Terracciano, Stefania; Altucci, Lucia; Chini, Maria Giovanna; Nebbioso, Angela; Bifulco, Giuseppe
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选、分子动力学模拟与化学蛋白质组学结合，研究新型抗癌剂破坏c-Myc/Max异源二聚化的分子机制，属于TF-DNA互作上游的蛋白-蛋白界面调控，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合建模，但核心非DNA互作。
abstract: The intrinsically disordered protein (IDP) c-Myc plays a crucial role in regulating cell growth, proliferation, and apoptosis, making it a significant target for cancer therapy. Herein, we report an integrated approach combining computational and biological methods to uncover key c-Myc structural aspects aimed at identifying modulators of this protein. A virtual screening campaign starting from commercially available libraries was performed, leading to the selection of 11 promising c-Myc binders. Preliminary biophysical and biological analysis, including Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) and MTT [(3-[4,5-dimethylthiazol-2-yl]-2,5 diphenyl tetrazolium bromide)] assays, highlighted three new potential c-Myc/Max heterodimerization inhibitors. Among them, 11 emerged as the most active one, displaying promising dissociation costant (K(D)) values on c-Myc (~ 60 muM), only slightly higher than the known binder 10058-F4 (with a K(D) ~ 40 muM) and on Max (with a K(D) ~ 80 muM). Notably, 11 showed significant antiproliferative effects on three different malignant cell lines (i.e., U937, HCT-116, and HT-29, as models of acute myeloid leukemia and colorectal cancer cell lines, respectively) in a dose- and cell-dependent manner. Importantly, a significant decrease in c-Myc levels was observed, especially in U937 leukemia cells with an 85 % reduction. Finally, molecular dynamics simulations and proteomic studies were performed to identify its binding site and key interacting residues. In summary, this work presents a robust research strategy and offers valuable insights for identifying new c-Myc/Max disruptors.
abstract_zh: intrinsically disordered protein (IDP) c-Myc 在调控细胞生长、增殖和凋亡中发挥关键作用，使其成为癌症治疗的重要靶点。在此，我们报告了一种结合计算与生物学方法的综合策略，以揭示c-Myc的关键结构特征，旨在识别该蛋白的调节剂。从商业可用文库出发进行虚拟筛选，最终选出11种有前景的c-Myc结合剂。初步的生物物理和生物学分析，包括表面等离子体共振 (Surface Plasmon Resonance, SPR) 和MTT [(3-[4,5-二甲基噻唑-2-基]-2,5-二苯基四唑溴化物)] 实验，突出了三种新的潜在c-Myc/Max异二聚化抑制剂。其中，化合物11表现出最强的活性，在c-Myc上显示出有前景的解离常数 (K(D)) 值（约60 μM），仅略高于已知结合剂10058-F4（K(D) 约40 μM），在Max上K(D) 约80 μM。值得注意的是，化合物11在三种不同恶性细胞系（即U937、HCT-116和HT-29，分别作为急性髓系白血病和结直肠癌细胞系模型）中显示出显著的抗增殖效应，且呈剂量和细胞依赖性。重要的是，观察到c-Myc水平显著下降，尤其在U937白血病细胞中减少达85%。最后，通过分子动力学模拟和蛋白质组学研究，确定了其结合位点和关键相互作用残基。总之，本研究提供了一种稳健的研究策略，并为识别新的c-Myc/Max干扰剂提供了宝贵见解。
